input.request: Build Custody Chain, a chain-of-custody handoff page for shipped goods. Token name: Custody Chain. Token symbol: CSTD. The fixed total supply is 1,000,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals (1,000,000,000 * 10^18 base units), minted once to the deployer. CustodyChain lets a shipper open a consignment for a bytes32 manifest hash, then the current holder offer the next leg by naming the next holder and paying a fixed CSTD carriage fee, which that holder collects when it accepts custody; the holder who made an offer may withdraw it and reclaim the fee if the named holder has not accepted within exactly 7 days. Anyone reads the current holder and the recorded legs. Deploy on Sepolia and publish a page to open a consignment, offer a leg, accept custody, withdraw a stale offer and read a consignment trail.
input.context: Sepolia only (chainId 11155111); GitHub and IPFS are approved. Include Foundry tests and an independent adversarial review. Constructors use only address, uint256, bool or bytes32 arguments; the launch token constructor is zero-argument. foundry.toml must set bytecode_hash = "none". No proxy, delegatecall or selfdestruct. Only the current holder offers a leg and only the named holder accepts it, so every transfer is sent by a party with goods or a carriage fee at risk. The manifest hash identifies a consignment publicly; it is not a shipment record.

draft.objective: Build and review CSTD and CustodyChain, deploy them on Sepolia, then publish the live chain-of-custody website.

steps.objective: Implement fixed-supply CSTD and the consignment handoff trail.
Test holder authorization, carriage fees, accept and withdraw paths, and trail reads.
Independently adversarially review custody transfer and fee accounting.
Build the live consignment, handoff and custody-trail page.
